% TATE pairs (JFM pair glue in tate data) -- pairfields API.
% Measures pair glue widths against the tate .def table by capturing the
% pairfields natural directly (the OLD kernmode/fixedpair capture macros
% were removed with the end_adjust rework: pair data now flows through
% \ptj@pairfields -> blendzw -> \ptj@nat).
% NOTE: the pair state (\ptj@lastclass etc.) must be set INSIDE the
% measurement hbox (the everyhbox frame hook neutralizes the outer
% state on box entry -- a box is a semantic frame), and the \setbox
% itself must be \global (the measurement group is closed before the
% width is read).
\documentclass[pdflatex,tate,paper=a5,line_length=20zw]{jlreq}
\makeatletter
\newbox\pbox
\newdimen\pmeasured
\newdimen\pexpected
\def\measurepair#1#2{% from,to
  \expandafter\ifx\csname ptj@jfm@pair@#1@#2\endcsname\relax
    \typeout{TATE-PAIR-SKIP: #1->#2 (undefined in table)}%
  \else
    % expected: evaluate the pairfields directly
    {\global\ptj@lastclass=#1\relax
     \global\ptj@curclass=#2\relax
     \global\ptj@lastzw=\ptj@zwreg
     \global\ptj@fbmode=0\relax
     \csname ptj@jfm@pair@#1@#2\endcsname
     \global\pexpected=\ptj@nat}%
    % measured: run the SAME boundary through the real emitter, with the
    % pair state set INSIDE the box (after the frame hook)
    \begingroup
      \global\setbox\pbox=\hbox{%
        \global\ptj@lastclass=#1\relax
        \global\ptj@curclass=#2\relax
        \global\ptj@inhibit=0\relax
        \global\ptj@lastzw=\ptj@zwreg
        \ptj@emitpair}%
    \endgroup
    \pmeasured=\wd\pbox
    \@tempdima=\dimexpr\pmeasured-\pexpected\relax
    \ifdim\@tempdima<\z@ \@tempdima=-\@tempdima \fi
    \ifdim\@tempdima<0.5pt\relax
      \typeout{TATE-PASS: PAIR #1->#2 (\the\pmeasured~==~\the\pexpected)}%
    \else
      \typeout{TATE-FAIL: PAIR #1->#2 (\the\pmeasured~!=~\the\pexpected)}%
    \fi
  \fi}
\begin{document}
\measurepair{15}{6}
\measurepair{15}{7}
\measurepair{1}{15}
\measurepair{7}{15}
\measurepair{6}{15}
\measurepair{15}{15}
\end{document}
